lead: NavIC is India's own version of GPS. A phone needs signals from at least four satellites to work out exactly where it is.
try: Press March 2026: 3, then Now, since Nov 2026: 4, and watch what changes.
points: With only three working satellites, NavIC could not give anyone their position on its own.
A new satellite, NVS-03, brought it back to four: just enough.
More satellites, spread across the sky, give a more accurate position.
